title: Rock Paper Scissors
description: Score a tournament under two interpretations of the strategy guide.
writeup:
## Approach

Each round's score is the sum of a shape score (1/2/3 for rock/paper/scissors) and an outcome score (0/3/6 for loss/draw/win). Both parts use lookup tables for all 9 possible matchups.

## Part 1

X/Y/Z represent rock/paper/scissors. Look up shape score and match outcome directly.

## Part 2

X/Y/Z now mean lose/draw/win. The outcome score is known; look up which shape to play to achieve that outcome against the opponent.
